verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official cubic CLI that reviews local changes before you push and generates a fix prompt for your coding agent, which fits AI-native workflows; a probe confirms the dedicated CLI docs page exists. The evidence is a single short first-party description, so the CLI's breadth is thin. Missing for 10: details on installation, commands, auth and non-interactive/scriptable usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
